name: Sahaja Online
reason: Condition-led, health rule: sahajaonline.com (robots allows us; domain found via a Sahaja meetup listing and confirmed on the site itself) leads with 'Guided Meditation for health' promising 'holistic healing' and relief of stress, anxiety and depression, addiction recovery and better sleep, and its main menu has pages on cancer, diabetes, HIV/AIDS, epilepsy, asthma, chronic pain, immunity and weight loss.
